name: @arena/demo
description: Deterministic Demo/Preview mode corpus + guided first-run narrative for Arena (Work Order B006; issue #73): a versioned, frozen seed corpus derived from the A028 software-engineer and A029 structural-engineer reference bodies, emitted as canonical B002 ControlPlaneRecords under a reserved demo tenant so demo reads go THROUGH the B005 canonical read path (never a parallel demo-only API). The corpus is deterministic by construction (no randomness, no wall-clock — a fixed narrative time constant; the corpus hash is computed and exported so determinism is testable), idempotently seedable and resettable through a DemoStore port (in-memory fake shipped; ControlPlaneRepository wiring possible later), and every surface consumes the exported labelling contract so demo state is always visibly labelled and can never be mistaken for customer-authoritative state.
